title: Goal C loop 2: continuous static-kappa certificate and sign-asymmetry range for the accepted U-V-W chain

accepted_c1_basis.graph_scope: actual Round18/Round19 four-cube graph with active vertical links U=(1,1,0), V=(1,0,0), W=(0,0,0) and all other links fixed
accepted_c1_basis.normalized_integral: F(kappa) = N(kappa) / Z(kappa), with N=int O exp(kappa*S) dmu and Z=int exp(kappa*S) dmu for the accepted common-V Haar measure
accepted_c1_basis.scope_warning: This is a static kappa integral checkpoint. It does not match kappa to a physical energy scale, time generator, dense limit, continuum Yang-Mills or Clay mass gap. Physical-scale matching remains open/unmatched.

goal: Upgrade C1 from a point kappa=1/64 certificate to a source-bound continuous static-kappa theorem over a declared interval, with an independent sign-asymmetry range and explicit failure/boundary diagnostics.

primary_target.statement: Prove with exact rational arithmetic that for K=1/8 and every real kappa with |kappa| <= K, F(0)=0 and F(kappa) >= kappa^2/2048. The kappa=0 case must be handled by the exact zeros N0=N1=0, not by division by kappa.
primary_target.suggested_route: Derive exact Taylor coefficients of N and Z from the accepted C1 moment formula through at least degree 8. Bound the numerator remainder uniformly by a rigorous exp(7K) or sharper source-bound tail, prove Z(kappa)>0 and use the correct denominator direction, e.g. an exact upper bound Z(kappa) <= E when converting a numerator lower bound to F(kappa) >= C_N/E * kappa^2.
primary_target.root_feasibility_hint_to_check_not_assum: The degree-8 route appeared feasible for K=1/8: C_N = N2 - sum_{n=3..8}|N_n| K^(n-2) - E*7^9*K^7/9! > 0, and C_N/E > 1/2048 for a rational E >= exp(7K). Both implementations must independently derive or falsify this, not import it as a premise.

secondary_target.statement: Prove a continuous sign-asymmetry theorem F(kappa) > F(-kappa) for a declared nonzero positive subrange. The required minimum target is 0 < kappa <= 1/64; extensions toward 1/8 are welcome only if certified.
secondary_target.suggested_route: Use the exact cross-difference D(kappa)=N(kappa)*Z(-kappa)-N(-kappa)*Z(kappa), denominator positivity, and the leading odd coefficient evidence from C1. The leading term should be checked against 2*N3*kappa^3 with N3=13/1296, with all higher terms and tails bounded exactly over the declared range.

required: Report whether the same degree-8 absolute-tail certificate proves K=1/7 and whether it fails at K=1/6; if it fails, record the exact negative or insufficient margin as a real boundary of that proof method, not as a theorem that positivity is false.
If claiming K>1/8 or K=1/6, supply a stronger independently checked certificate; otherwise leave it open rather than widening the accepted range.
Preserve the C1 point kappa=1/64 intervals as regression evidence only; they are not by themselves a continuous theorem.

forward: derive the accepted C1 moment/coefficient model from source-bound graph data or accepted C1 artifacts, not from hard-coded final inequalities
produce exact N and Z Taylor coefficients, exact interval/range proof for |kappa|<=1/8, denominator positivity and the denominator-bound direction used in the lower bound
prove or limit the sign-asymmetry range using the cross-difference D(kappa)
include boundary diagnostics for K=1/7 and K=1/6 under the stated degree-8/tail method
produce normal and optimized deterministic outputs, source manifest, report and mutation controls
backward: independently reconstruct the coefficient and tail certificate, preferably by a distinct moment/fusion or interval-arithmetic route
compare the forward theorem, coefficients, declared range, denominator bounds, sign-asymmetry proof and boundary diagnostics against actual file hashes
include fail-closed source and manifest checks, normal and optimized comparison outputs, and genuine mutations for each admitted theorem component

acceptance_criteria: Both implementations bind to accepted C1 gate bytes and recover the C1 defining graph/action/observable or explicitly justify using the accepted source-bound C1 coefficient model.
Exact rational coefficient rows include at least N0,N1,N2,N3 and Z0,Z1,Z2,Z3 as listed, plus enough higher rows to support the declared tail certificate.
The primary positivity theorem is continuous over the whole declared interval; no finite kappa sample or C1 point interval is promoted to a range theorem.
Denominator positivity and the upper/lower direction used to divide the numerator bound are stated and mechanically checked.
The kappa=0 endpoint is handled exactly before any division by kappa^2 or kappa^3.
The sign-asymmetry theorem uses an exact cross-difference or equivalent proof and states its certified interval separately from the positivity interval.
K=1/7 and K=1/6 diagnostics are reported without overclaiming; a failure of the crude certificate is labeled as method insufficiency unless a theorem proves actual failure.
The independent comparison validates theorem content and file hashes and includes real mutations, not Boolean presence checks.
All reports explicitly mark static kappa as physically unmatched and make no continuum or Clay-mass-gap claim.
falsifying_controls: delete or alter N2=1/324 or N3=13/1296 and require rejection
set N0 or N1 nonzero and require endpoint/division logic to reject
reuse the C1 kappa=1/64 interval as a continuous range proof and require rejection
replace the common-V measure with independent V resampling so E[x*z*w*t]=0 and require rejection for the primary C1-derived model
use the wrong denominator inequality direction, such as dividing by an unproved lower/upper bound in a way that increases the claimed lower bound, and require rejection
omit denominator positivity or allow an interval division whose denominator crosses zero and require rejection
underestimate the exponential/tail remainder, use numerical floating sampling in place of exact rational bounds, or silently round an outward bound inward and require rejection
divide by kappa^2 or kappa^3 at kappa=0 without a separate analytic endpoint argument and require rejection
remove the odd cross-difference term or flip the sign-asymmetry inequality while preserving point intervals and require rejection
claim K=1/6 from the crude degree-8 certificate when its exact margin is insufficient unless a stronger proof is supplied and independently checked
substitute Fibonacci index, E_star, alpha ratio or physical energy wording for static kappa and require rejection
claim physical scale matching, dense convergence, continuum Yang-Mills or a spectral/mass gap from this static integral and require rejection
stop_condition: Stop after C2 evidence and advisor gate. Then write the updated next-three roadmap from all six accepted/limited/rejected loops, keeping the eight completed stages separate from future plans and explicitly preserving the open physical-scale bridge and finite-convergence/dense-limit questions.
